title: Import/export
description: Take a whole client out of Forgecy in one file, or bring one in.

areas.brandHint: Every version with its status and changelog, decided proposals, sources and observations.
areas.brandBookHint: Exported PDFs and Brand System ZIPs.
areas.templatesHint: Template packages with their fonts and assets.
areas.auditHint: Data, observations with evidence, screenshots, diagnosis, report drafts and plan.
areas.contentHint: Images with their provenance, carousels with versions and exported files, plans and automations.
areas.reportsHint: Audit report PDFs and their export history.
areas.activityHint: The client's activity log as CSV. It is not imported back.

export.includeAgencyTemplates: Include the agency templates the client used
export.confirm: Export {client}? The package is built in the background; you can leave this page.
export.started: Export started. It appears below, and in the bell when it is ready.
export.noAreas: Choose at least one thing to include.

summary.title: Summary
summary.rows: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing yet} one {# item} other {# items}}
summary.warning: The package contains client data: keep it like a confidential document.
summary.pick: Choose a client to see what its package will contain.

recent.title: Recent exports
recent.empty: No exports yet. Choose a client to build its full package.
recent.linkHint: Download links are valid for 24 hours.

errors.invalidInput: Check the export choices and try again.
errors.exportFailed: The export did not succeed. Try again; if it fails again, check System health.
errors.notReady: This export is not ready, or its file is no longer available.
errors.importNotReady: This import cannot be confirmed now: check its state and try again.
errors.invalidChoices: Check the choices for each conflict and try again.
errors.typedNameMismatch: The typed name does not match the client: type it exactly as shown.
errors.slugTaken: The address “{slug}” is already used by another client: choose another one.
errors.unresolvedConflicts: {count, plural, one {# conflict still needs a choice.} other {# conflicts still need a choice.}}
errors.importFailed: The import did not succeed. Nothing was changed: the import writes everything at the end.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload did not succeed. Try again.
errors.notZip: Choose the ZIP file of a Forgecy client package.

file.title: Choose the package
file.hint: The ZIP made by “Export client”, in this or another Forgecy installation. Up to {size}.
file.label: Client package (ZIP)

verifying.title: Checking the package…
verifying.body: Forgecy reads the manifest and checks every file against its checksum. You can leave the page: the result stays here.

problems.unreadable: This file is not a Forgecy client package or it is damaged.
problems.format: This package uses a format this version does not know.
problems.newerVersion: The package comes from a newer Forgecy. Update Forgecy before importing this package.
problems.checksum: Some files in the package do not match their checksum: the package is damaged. Export it again.
problems.unknownTable: The package contains data this version of Forgecy does not know. Update Forgecy before importing it.
problems.unsafe: The package refers to data or files that do not belong to the client it describes, so it cannot be imported.

conflicts.counter: {open, plural, =0 {No conflicts to resolve} one {# conflict to resolve} other {# conflicts to resolve}} · {auto, plural, =0 {none resolved automatically} other {# resolved automatically}}
conflicts.none: No conflicts: the client will be imported as new.
conflicts.clientLegend: Client “{name}”: a client with the same name or address already exists (“{existing}”).
conflicts.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens: the client opens at /clients/{slug}.
conflicts.replaceHint: Destructive: you confirm it by typing the client’s name in the last step.
conflicts.importDraft: Import as a new version in Draft
conflicts.authorMatched: {name} ({email}): matched to the person with the same email.
conflicts.authorMissing: {name} ({email}): not a person here. Their changes are kept without an author.

confirm.create: A new client “{name}” is created at /clients/{slug}.
confirm.replace: The current data of {name} ({versions, plural, one {# Brand Identity version} other {# Brand Identity versions}}, {carousels, plural, one {# carousel} other {# carousels}}, {audits, plural, one {# audit} other {# audits}}) will be replaced by the package’s. Before the import Forgecy creates a backup of the database.
confirm.templatesDraft: {count, plural, one {# template is imported as a new version in Draft.} other {# templates are imported as new versions in Draft.}}
confirm.states: Versions keep their status and history; the published version stays published. Carousels in review go back to Draft.

import.started: Import started. You can leave the page: a notification arrives when it ends.

importing.title: Importing {name}…
importing.body: Everything is written at the end, in one go. You can leave the page: a notification arrives when it ends.
